Location: Mumbai
Description:

Recruitment interviews are being held in Mumbai for culinary and galley positions on international cruise ships. Openings include Sous Chef, Chef de Partie, Commis I, and Commis II in various restaurant and galley specialities, including fine dining, hot pot, steak house, baking, butchery, and pastry.
